name: erpnext-operations
description: Manage ERPNext Operations through the built-in Codex browser using the account selected for the current project, with optional read-only CLI/helper diagnostics.

interface.longDescription: Use the active browser account for project-specific organization administration, finance, sales, buying/stock, manufacturing, people/projects/support, content, and analytics. Management changes use visible UI controls; CLI/helper logs and status are optional read-only supplements with independently verified scope. Browser onboarding requires no API tokens.
defaultPrompt: Open my ERPNext site in the built-in Codex browser and verify the user, company, and project.
Inspect my ERPNext Operations resources without changes.
Plan a ERPNext Operations operation and show its target and impact.
